about_the_game:
In Lott, history and legend entwine on a small island caught in the shadow of invasion. You play as Lott, a courageous Maltese weasel, chosen to recover the shattered dagger of La Vallette — a relic said to carry the spirit of unity and defiance.

But the path is not simple. Ancient folklore beasts, bound in chains of conquest, stand in your way. Each encounter asks: will you fight them… or set them free?

Explore Malta Reimagined

Traverse sun-baked villages, limestone fortresses, and wild cliffs shaped by the Mediterranean sea breeze. Every location draws from Malta’s history and myth, but with a vivid, stylized identity that feels both timeless and new.

Fight or Negotiate

Engage in fast, tactile combat — weaving dodges, strikes, and abilities. Or choose to confront bosses through dialogue and negotiation, learning their stories and reshaping the fate of creatures once thought monstrous.

A Shattered Legacy

Collect shards of the dagger of La Vallette, each hidden deep within fortresses, caves, and folklore domains. Piece them together to rekindle hope and uncover the truth of why myth and history are inseparable.

Key Features

  • A unique isometric action-adventure inspired by Maltese history and legends.

  • Dual-path encounters: fight or negotiate with folklore bosses.

  • Stylized vinyl-toy art style bringing Malta’s fauna and myths to life.

  • Exploration & discovery across diverse Mediterranean environments.

  • A narrative of unity, courage, and choice, where every shard matters.

name: LOTT

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8250U (4 * 1800) or equivalent; AMD Phenom II X4 965 (4 * 3400) or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce MX 150 ( 2048 MB); Radeon R7 260X (2048 MB)
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670K (4 * 3400) or equivalent; AMD FX-8350 (8 * 4700) or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 ( 2048 MB); Radeon RX 580 (8192 MB)
  • Storage: 30 GB available space

short_description: The Great Siege reshaped Malta, but legends endured. Play as Lott, a humble weasel called to reclaim a shattered dagger of hope. Explore myth, confront folklore beasts, and choose between battle or mercy in a fight for unity.
